notes.title: Shattered Memories DEMO 0.5 Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! Shattered Memories DEMO 0.5 Update is here! I made some small changes for the demo: 

- Change to the "A Hidden Place" level 
- Added running in the Exploration level 
- Easier Masahiko boss fight 
- Added boss hp bar[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610104/ab27b84e09b74fdc4ef2f765fd543b7de0483b90.png"][/img][/p][p]That’s all! Have fun! Be sure to follow my social medias for updates![/p]
